unlocks.reward: Whisper's Edge: attacks with this weapon cannot be parried. +1d4 psychic damage on every hit.

unlocks.condition: Carve the name of a living target into the blade's flat while speaking their name aloud.
unlocks.reward: Against your Marked Target: +3d8 piercing damage, attacks made with advantage, they cannot become invisible within 1 mile of you. You always know their direction and distance. Mark resets only on their death.

unlocks.condition: Kill the person you loved most. Must be a genuine relationship recognized by the GM.
unlocks.reward: +5 to all attack and damage rolls with this weapon. You can no longer lie in any form — the blade rings and the truth is spoken in your voice. Cannot remove attunement without a Wish spell.

name: Thornmaul
flavorText: A warhammer grown from petrified heartwood of a corrupted treant.
description: +4 attack and damage. Critical hit: thorny vines erupt from the wound, rooting the target until end of their next turn (DC 18 Strength to end early). Requires attunement.

unlocks.condition: Deal the killing blow to 15 plant-type creatures or treants with this weapon.
unlocks.reward: Root choice on hit: Restrain target (1d8 piercing per turn, DC 16 Strength action to escape). Roots persist even if you drop the weapon.

unlocks.condition: Bring this weapon to a corrupted or dying ancient forest and let a druid or nature deity witness you striking a living tree with it.
unlocks.reward: The maul awakens. Speak with Plants and Commune with Nature simultaneously as a 1-minute ritual, once per day. +2 to attack and damage (total +6). Empathic communication with plants within 60 ft.

unlocks.condition: Strike down an innocent creature sheltering beneath a living tree, knowingly.
unlocks.reward: You take 1d4 piercing damage when gripping the weapon. Critical hits now entangle ALL creatures within 20 ft. +2d8 piercing on critical hits. Difficult terrain of vines appears within 15 ft. of any creature you kill.

name: The Last Word
flavorText: An elven longbow strung with a lock of hair from a dying god.
description: +4 attack and damage. The nocked arrow seeks the first creature to have drawn the wielder's blood this combat (advantage on this attack). Requires attunement by an elf.

unlocks.condition: Kill 10 creatures using this bow without speaking a word during those encounters. Complete silence.
unlocks.reward: Arrows are completely silent — including impact. Advantage on Stealth while holding this bow and not speaking. Cannot be heard when nocking an arrow.

unlocks.condition: Draw this bow in the presence of a deity or divine avatar (CR 20+) and loose an arrow at them.
unlocks.reward: Against creatures with Legendary Resistance: hits reduce their remaining uses by 1. Once per day: silence a spell being verbalized — the spell fails with no slot expended.

unlocks.condition: Spend a full long rest in quiet at the grave, relic site, or final resting place of the god whose hair strings this bow.
unlocks.reward: The bow speaks one word to you — the name of the thing you most fear losing. Once per week: loose an arrow that cannot miss any named target on any plane — it travels around corners, through walls, across planes if needed.

name: Grudgebearer
flavorText: A dwarven battleaxe carried by seven generations of mountain kings.
description: +4 attack and damage. For each unhealed wound the wielder carries: +1d6 extra damage (max +3d6). The axe is warm when the bearer is being lied to. Requires attunement by a dwarf.

unlocks.condition: Carry at least 3 unhealed wounds simultaneously and win a combat encounter.
unlocks.reward: The +1d6 per unhealed wound cap (previously +3d6) is removed — no limit on stacking. The blade permanently smells of old iron.

unlocks.condition: Engrave 5 or more names of genuine enemies into the haft using the axe's blade.
unlocks.reward: Against any named creature: +2d10 damage per hit. Reducing a named target to 0 HP restores 10 HP to you. The axe pulses when any named creature is within 30 ft.

unlocks.tierLabel: Tier III — The Grudge That Eats (Curse)
unlocks.condition: Spare someone whose name is on the haft — fully and knowingly — in front of witnesses.
unlocks.reward: +4 attack and damage permanently. However: any creature you reduce to 0 HP dies outright — no stabilizing, no prisoners. This cannot be undone while attuned.

name: Nightsong (Paired Daggers)
flavorText: A matched pair of curved daggers forged by shadow-dancers who worked only by moonlight.
description: +4 attack and damage each. Finesse, light. Once per short rest: teleport up to 10 ft. to any area of dim light or darkness within sight. Requires attunement.

unlocks.condition: Perform 20 Sneak Attacks or hidden hits using these daggers.
unlocks.reward: Teleport range increases from 10 to 30 ft. Destination now includes any shadow cast by a Medium or larger creature. Darkvision 120 ft. and see through magical darkness while both daggers are drawn.

unlocks.tierLabel: Tier II — The Choir of Blades
unlocks.condition: Kill 5 named NPCs using both daggers in the same encounter within the same night.
unlocks.reward: When you teleport, bring one willing creature of your size or smaller. Hear hostile intent half a second before a blow — advantage on initiative, cannot be surprised while both daggers are drawn.

unlocks.condition: Accept a contract to kill someone, then refuse to complete it after accepting payment.
unlocks.reward: Permanently attuned — cannot remove voluntarily. On a killing blow: all creatures within 30 ft. make DC 16 Wisdom save or are Frightened. On a kill: absorb one of the target's proficiencies for 24 hours. Cannot be charmed.

name: Bonecrusher, the Giant's Toy
flavorText: An enormous maul once belonging to a hill giant chieftain, later cursed and abandoned.
description: +4 attack and damage. Critical hit: target knocked prone, ground cracks in 10-ft radius (difficult terrain). Heavy, two-handed. Requires attunement by a creature with Strength 20+.

unlocks.condition: Deal the killing blow to 5 giants using this weapon.
unlocks.reward: +4d6 bludgeoning on hits against giants. Giants you kill cannot be resurrected or raised as undead — their bones crumble to gravel.

unlocks.condition: Defeat a giant clan's chieftain in single combat and claim their title by tradition.
unlocks.reward: Giant's Decree: once per day, giants within 120 ft. make DC 18 Wisdom save or obey one command for 1 round. Giants who fail have disadvantage on attacks against you permanently.

unlocks.condition: Tell a genuinely funny joke while wielding this weapon in front of at least 5 witnesses who all laugh involuntarily.
unlocks.reward: The maul's low rattling chuckle is constant and audible within 30 ft. — cannot be stealthy. In exchange: on a critical hit, all enemies within 30 ft. make DC 18 Wisdom save or spend their next action laughing (Incapacitated).

name: The Fair Warning
flavorText: A masterwork siege crossbow that ended a famous siege with a single bolt from three hundred yards.
description: +4 attack and damage. Range 200/800. The first bolt fired each day cannot miss (automatic hit). Loading: bonus action required. Two-handed. Requires attunement.

unlocks.condition: Fire the opening shot in 5 different military conflicts or sieges, witnessed by at least 10 combatants.
unlocks.reward: Range increases to 400/1600. The no-miss bolt can also pin targets to surfaces — Restrained until bolt removed (DC 17 Strength action).

unlocks.condition: Fire the bolt that ends a war — witnessed by leaders of both sides, precipitating peace or surrender.
unlocks.reward: No-miss bolt upgrades: can curve around full cover and hit targets not in line of sight, if seen within 10 minutes. Creatures killed cannot be resurrected without a Wish spell.

unlocks.condition: Refuse to fire when given a clear shot at a primary enemy (tyrant, lich, dragon in range) when the GM signals the moment.
unlocks.reward: Future no-miss shots require DC 15 Wisdom save or fire at nearest creature regardless of allegiance. In exchange: every kill visible to allies grants them 5 temporary HP.

name: Frosthowl
flavorText: A greatsword of blue-white steel, always rimed with frost.
description: +4 attack and damage, +2d8 cold damage on hit. Target's speed halved until end of their next turn. Wielder immune to cold damage. Requires attunement.

unlocks.condition: Spend 7 consecutive days in extreme cold (below -30°F) without magical protection, while attuned.
unlocks.reward: Movement in snow/ice +10 ft. Immune to the Slowed condition from cold. Target's speed reduction from hits lasts until end of their next turn OR until they deal fire damage.

unlocks.condition: Kill 10 wolves or winter wolves. On the 10th, let the wolf see you clearly before it dies — do not strike from hiding.
unlocks.reward: Once per day: summon 4 Winter Wolves for 1 hour. While the pack is present, all cold damage from you or the wolves ignores resistance.

unlocks.condition: Challenge and defeat a Winter Wolf Elder (CR 8+) or Frost Giant Jarl in single combat — no allies may assist.
unlocks.reward: Exalted state. Cone of Cold (DC 18, 12d8) usable twice per day. Cold damage ignores immunity. You permanently sprout subtle wolf-like features while attuned.

name: Coinsplitter (Twin Shortswords)
flavorText: A pair of short swords forged from melted-down coins.
description: +4 attack and damage each. Finesse, light. Once per day: a successful hit also pickpockets one small item from the target (GM discretion). Requires attunement.

unlocks.tierLabel: Tier I — Sleight of the Blade
unlocks.condition: Successfully steal 1,000 gp total value using these blades' pickpocket ability, across any hits.
unlocks.reward: Pickpocket now lifts any item the target carries — including weapons, foci, or spell components. Once per day, a hit also duplicates one gold coin from the target's pouch.

unlocks.condition: Sell 5,000 gp worth of stolen goods to the same fence or black market contact over multiple sessions.
unlocks.reward: Coin Magnetism: aware of all currency within 30 ft. Cannot be robbed. Gold you spend has 10% chance (roll d10, on 10) to return to your purse by end of day.

unlocks.tierLabel: Tier III — The House Always Wins (Curse)
unlocks.condition: Gamble away at least 500 gp in one session and lose it all intentionally — knowing you will lose.
unlocks.reward: Luck Inversion: enemy critical hits against you become normal hits. However: gold above 100 gp disappears at end of each long rest — taken by the swords' original owner.

name: Aegis of the Last Stand
flavorText: Plate armor forged from the melted shields of a hundred knights who held a doomed line.
description: AC 22. Once per long rest: if reduced to 0 HP, drop to 1 HP instead (armor rings audibly for 1 mile). Resistance to all damage while at 1–20 HP. Requires attunement.

unlocks.condition: Be reduced to 0 HP, survive using the armor's 1 HP ability, and remain standing until the end of that combat.
unlocks.reward: The save-from-0-HP ability now triggers twice per long rest. When it triggers, the bell-ring grants all allies within 60 ft. 1d10 temporary HP.

unlocks.condition: Protect an ally from lethal damage 10 times — step between them and an attack that would have killed them.
unlocks.reward: Resistance to all damage while below 50 HP. Once per long rest as a reaction: take all remaining damage from an attack that would kill an ally — they drop to 1 HP instead.

unlocks.condition: Survive a battle where at least 5 allies die and you do not flee — be the last one standing, surrounded by enemies.
unlocks.reward: Cannot die while any ally within 30 ft. is conscious. When finally the last one standing: all enemies within 60 ft. take 10d10 radiant (no save). You choose to die or survive at 1 HP. Fallen allies' names etch inside the armor.

name: Cloak of the Hundred Faces
flavorText: A spymaster's cloak sewn from a hundred discarded illusions.
description: Alter apparent face and voice at will (no action). True Seeing of 8th level or higher only can penetrate this disguise. Occasionally shows a random stranger's face in reflections. Requires attunement.

unlocks.condition: Maintain a single disguise for 30 consecutive in-game days without being discovered by any NPC who knew you before.
unlocks.reward: Perfectly replicate voice, mannerisms, and phrasing of anyone you've spoken with for 10+ minutes. Insight checks against your disguise have disadvantage even against Truesight of 7th level or lower.

unlocks.condition: Successfully impersonate 10 different named NPCs, each convincingly enough that they're fooled.
unlocks.reward: Stored faces held permanently. Switch between any stored face as a bonus action. Access surface memories of that person — their name, occupation, family, and last action. Feel their emotions faintly.

unlocks.tierLabel: Tier III — The Hundred Become One (Curse)
unlocks.condition: Go 10 consecutive in-game days without speaking or writing your own name — not even in private.
unlocks.reward: Your original face is gone. The cloak cycles through stored faces randomly while you sleep. +4 Charisma. Those who knew you feel unsettled even seeing your original face — they sense something is wrong but cannot articulate it.

name: Ironhide Vestments
flavorText: Chain from the hide of an ironback boar that took a village three days to bring down.
description: AC 17. Resistance to piercing damage. Makes a low grunt when the wearer is startled or surprised. Requires attunement.

unlocks.condition: Be struck by 50 total piercing attacks while wearing this armor (cumulative).
unlocks.reward: Immunity to mundane piercing weapons (non-magical). Resistance to slashing damage added. The grunt gives 1 round of advance warning before ambushes.

unlocks.condition: Press this armor against the blood of a freshly killed boar or large beast once per month for 3 consecutive months.
unlocks.reward: Gore attack (1d10+Str, bonus action). On a charge (20+ ft. straight): 3d10+Str instead. AC increases to 19. While below half HP: all attacks deal +2d6 piercing damage.

unlocks.condition: Refuse to retreat from 5 separate encounters where retreat would have been tactically correct, surviving each one.
unlocks.reward: Cannot flee — movement away from nearest enemy costs double. In exchange: resistance to all damage while you haven't moved more than 10 ft. in the previous round. +2 AC when you don't move on your turn.

name: Shield of the Unbroken Line
flavorText: A tower shield passed down an unbroken line of border-guard captains for three centuries.
description: +3 AC (on top of standard shield bonus — total +5 AC from this shield). Once per day: as a reaction, reduce one attack's damage to 0. A new notch appears on the rim each time this triggers. The shield has never been broken and is immune to the Shatter spell. Requires attunement.

unlocks.condition: Use the shield's damage-reduction reaction 10 times.
unlocks.reward: Reaction now usable twice per day. When triggered, allies within 10 ft. also take 0 damage from the same attack (not just half).

unlocks.condition: Carry this shield into 3 different wars, sieges, or declared military conflicts.
unlocks.reward: The Line Holds: while you haven't moved this round, you and all allies within 10 ft. have resistance to all damage. Moving ends this effect until your next turn.

unlocks.condition: Stand between an unarmed civilian and certain death, take the killing blow yourself, and survive — the civilian must live.
unlocks.reward: AC bonus increases to +4. Once per long rest: create a 30-ft wall of force lasting 1 minute — all attacks against creatures behind it miss automatically. The shield names itself and will tell you in a dream.

name: Boots of the Wanderer King
flavorText: Worn by a king who walked away from his own coronation.
description: Never fatigued from walking. Always sense direction of nearest settlement. Ignore non-magical difficult terrain. No attunement required.

unlocks.condition: Travel more than 500 miles from where you started your adventuring career while wearing these boots.
unlocks.reward: Your walking speed increases by 10 ft. while wearing them, and you no longer need food or water while traveling (you still benefit from consuming them if available).

unlocks.condition: Visit 10 settlements you have never set foot in before while wearing these boots.
unlocks.reward: Once per long rest, sense the direction and rough distance to any specific place or person you have previously visited or met, not just the nearest settlement.

unlocks.tierLabel: Tier III — The King Never Rests (Curse)
unlocks.condition: Go 30 consecutive days without sleeping in the same location twice.
unlocks.reward: Permanently attuned. You cannot be tracked by non-magical means and are immune to exhaustion caused by travel, but you gain disadvantage on saving throws against being frightened while indoors within a building you own or call home.

name: Gauntlets of the Iron Handshake
flavorText: Forged for a diplomat famous for ending a war with a spine-cracking handshake.
description: Unarmed strikes deal 1d8 bludgeoning damage. Advantage on Strength (Athletics) grapple checks. Advantage on Charisma (Intimidation) when threatening physical force. Requires attunement.

unlocks.condition: Win 10 grapple or shove contests while wearing these gauntlets.
unlocks.reward: Unarmed strike damage increases to 1d10 bludgeoning. Advantage on checks and saves to resist being grappled, restrained, or shoved.

unlocks.condition: Successfully intimidate 15 different creatures while wearing these gauntlets.
unlocks.reward: Once per short rest, a successful unarmed strike can stun the target until the end of its next turn (DC 15 Constitution save negates).

unlocks.condition: Reduce a creature to 0 hit points with an unarmed strike from these gauntlets.
unlocks.reward: Permanently attuned. Your unarmed strikes count as magical and deal an extra 1d6 damage, but you have disadvantage on Charisma (Persuasion) checks — people who've heard what your hands can do don't relax around you.

name: Helm of the Second Sight
flavorText: Worn by an oracle who saw her own death three times and changed the outcome each time.
description: +1 AC. Advantage on initiative rolls. Cannot be surprised while wearing it. Once per day: before making an initiative roll, you may declare you act first this round (overrides normal initiative order). Requires attunement.

unlocks.condition: Use the helm's act-first ability in 5 different encounters where you were not the highest initiative.
unlocks.reward: Act-first ability upgrades to twice per day. Once per day, the GM gives a cryptic single-sentence hint about what will happen in the next encounter before it begins.

unlocks.condition: Deliberately allow a future you foresaw to happen without attempting to prevent it, and let it play out.
unlocks.reward: True Prophecy once per week: meditate 1 hour, the GM describes one event in specific detail occurring within 7 in-game days. You cannot change this event — but you can prepare.

unlocks.condition: Witness your own death in a vision and accept it without attempting to deny or prevent it.
unlocks.reward: Truesight 60 ft. permanently. Once per day: ask the GM one yes/no question about the future — they must answer honestly. Once per long rest: rewind 6 seconds for the entire battlefield (everyone retains memory of what happened).

name: Robes of the Still Storm
flavorText: Woven by a monastic order trained in the eye of a hurricane.
description: +2 AC. Immune to the Prone condition and cannot be moved against your will by wind, gust, or force effects. When a creature hits you with a melee attack: you can use your reaction to force them to make a DC 16 Strength save or be pushed back 10 ft. The hem moves at all times regardless of air. Requires attunement by a monk or druid.

unlocks.tierLabel: Tier I — Eye of the Storm
unlocks.condition: Maintain concentration on a spell for its full maximum duration in 10 separate encounters while taking damage each time.
unlocks.reward: Concentration spells last twice as long (up to their listed max, then doubled). Once per encounter: automatically succeed one Constitution save to maintain concentration.

unlocks.condition: Find and spend one week in meditation at the storm-wracked mountain monastery where these robes were woven.
unlocks.reward: Tempest Form once per day for 1 minute: partially incorporeal (immune to non-magical bludgeoning, piercing, slashing). Constant Gust of Wind 30-ft radius. Move through other creatures' spaces. Ignore difficult terrain.

unlocks.condition: Strike a monk or druid engaged in peaceful meditation without warning while they are defenseless.
unlocks.reward: Constant thunder aura — cannot be stealthy. In exchange: while Incorporeal, melee attackers take 2d8 thunder damage. Spells deal +2d6 thunder. Immune to thunder and lightning damage.

name: Elixir of the Phoenix's Breath
flavorText: Distilled from a single feather shed willingly by a phoenix.
description: Restores 10d4+20 HP. If used on a creature at 0 HP: they rise wreathed in harmless warm flame for one round. Action to use on an unconscious ally.

unlocks.condition: Use an Elixir of the Phoenix's Breath (or another found later) to stabilize or revive an ally on 3 separate occasions.
unlocks.reward: Future uses restore an additional 2d4 HP, and the harmless warm flame grants the target resistance to fire damage for 1 minute.

unlocks.condition: Use the elixir on an ally who was reduced to 0 HP by fire damage.
unlocks.reward: When used on a creature at 0 HP, that creature also removes one exhaustion level and stands up with 1 temporary hit point that lingers until the start of their next turn.

name: Draught of a Thousand Faces
flavorText: An opalescent potion brewed for a client who was never named.
description: Assume the exact appearance of any humanoid you have seen, for 24 hours. Provides the body — not the voice. Your own accent persists regardless.

unlocks.tierLabel: Tier I — A Face Worth Keeping
unlocks.condition: Successfully deceive 5 different creatures using a disguise granted by this draught (or another of its kind).
unlocks.reward: The disguise now also alters your voice to match, and lasts for 48 hours instead of 24.

unlocks.tierLabel: Tier II — Nobody You've Ever Been
unlocks.condition: Use the draught's disguise to infiltrate a location you could not otherwise have entered.
unlocks.reward: You may now also mimic the exact voice and minor mannerisms of anyone you've spent at least 10 minutes observing, in addition to their appearance.

name: Vial of Borrowed Time
flavorText: A silvery liquid that moves against the current of its vial.
description: Act twice on your next turn (two complete turns worth of actions). Immediately after: gain 1 level of exhaustion.

unlocks.condition: Use a Vial of Borrowed Time to directly turn the tide of a combat you would otherwise likely have lost.
unlocks.reward: The exhaustion level gained afterward is removed automatically after your next short rest instead of requiring a long rest.

unlocks.condition: Use 3 Vials of Borrowed Time within the same 7-day period.
unlocks.reward: You may act twice on your next turn as normal, but immediately after your following turn, you gain 2 levels of exhaustion instead of 1 for that use only.

name: Scroll of the Final Verse
flavorText: A scroll of singing script — the last spell a legendary archmage cast before retiring.
description: Cast any 6th-level spell you have personally witnessed cast, once, without components. The scroll burns away as ash shaped like musical notes.

unlocks.condition: Use the scroll to cast a spell that saves an ally's life.
unlocks.reward: You may cast the spell without needing to have personally witnessed anyone cast it, so long as you know of the spell by name and general effect.

unlocks.tierLabel: Tier II — The Song Doesn't End
unlocks.condition: Successfully cast 3 different 6th-level spells using scrolls of this kind over the course of your adventures.
unlocks.reward: The musical-note ash the scroll leaves behind can be gathered and used as a divine focus for your next spell cast within 1 minute, granting a +1 bonus to its save DC.

name: Powdered Star-Iron
flavorText: A pouch of silvery dust ground from a fragment of a fallen star.
description: Coat a weapon over 1 minute: +1d6 force damage on hit for 1 hour. Overcomes any resistance or immunity to non-magical damage. Weapon emits a sustained hum while active.

unlocks.tierLabel: Tier I — Iron From the Sky
unlocks.condition: Use star-iron-coated weapons to deal a combined 100 damage to creatures normally resistant or immune to non-magical damage.
unlocks.reward: The coating now lasts 8 hours instead of 1, and the bonus damage increases to 1d8.

unlocks.tierLabel: Tier II — The Weapon Remembers the Stars
unlocks.condition: Coat 5 different weapons with star-iron powder over the course of your adventures.
unlocks.reward: You can now coat two weapons from a single application (yours and one ally's, or two of your own), so long as both are coated within the same minute.

name: Tears of the Unburied Queen
flavorText: A crystal vial of tears wept by a queen who refused to die before finishing her revenge.
description: Restores 6d10+12 HP. Also cures any one curse or disease. The drinker weeps uncontrollably but harmlessly for about a minute.

unlocks.condition: Use the tears to cure a curse or disease on an ally, not yourself.
unlocks.reward: Future uses restore an additional 2d10 HP, and the weeping period no longer causes disadvantage on Perception checks during it.

unlocks.condition: Use 3 vials of these tears over the course of your adventures.
unlocks.reward: The cure effect now also removes one level of exhaustion in addition to curing curses and disease.

name: The Gambler's Last Coin
flavorText: A tarnished coin that has never once landed the way its holder wanted — except when it mattered most.
description: Once per week: reroll any single failed roll (before knowing the outcome). Must accept the new result. Sometimes spins on its edge for exactly ten seconds before falling.

unlocks.condition: Use the coin's reroll ability 10 times and have at least 7 produce a better result than the original.
unlocks.reward: Once per day: reroll any creature's die roll within 60 ft. (yours or theirs) and choose either result. The coin now spins for 15 seconds instead of 10 before falling.

unlocks.condition: Win a wager of at least 500 gp against unfavorable odds without using the coin's ability.
unlocks.reward: Probability Sense: always know approximate odds of any proposed course of action (GM tells you: good, even, poor, or terrible odds). Cannot be cheated at games of chance.

unlocks.condition: Lose a bet on something genuinely important — wagered something you could not afford to lose and lost it, without using magic to change the outcome.
unlocks.reward: Once per week: an unknown benefactor provides one service or clears one debt (GM determines form). However: once per month the coin calls in its own favor — GM chooses what you must do. Refusing costs you 3 automatic reroll failures.

name: Signet of the Forgotten House
flavorText: A heavy signet ring bearing the crest of a house erased from every record.
description: +3 AC (ring of protection). Opens any door or lock inscribed with a heraldic crest. Strangers occasionally show unearned deference, then look confused. Requires attunement.

unlocks.condition: Research and document the complete history of the Forgotten House — its name, members, and how it was erased — and present this to a historian or court.
unlocks.reward: Any door, vault, or lock bearing a noble crest opens at your touch. Noble NPCs treat you as a peer regardless of your actual title.

unlocks.condition: Spend at least 1,000 gp to restore, rebuild, or formally re-establish the Forgotten House in some capacity.
unlocks.reward: Gain a loyal retainer from the restored house who cannot be bought, charmed, or deceived into betrayal. Once per day: cast Sending without components to any noble or ruling-class member on the plane.

unlocks.condition: Have yourself deliberately erased from an official record — your name removed from a census, guild roster, or kingdom's birth records — by your own hand.
unlocks.reward: Creatures who meet you have disadvantage on checks to recall your appearance or name 24 hours later. Once per week: erase one NPC's memory of you completely (DC 18 Wisdom to resist). Your name fades from documents written by others within 1 month.

name: The Hourglass That Lies
flavorText: A palm-sized hourglass whose sand does not fall at a consistent rate.
description: Once per day: rewind the last 6 seconds for yourself alone (limited Timestop equivalent). One grain of sand always falls upward when this happens.

unlocks.condition: Use the 6-second rewind ability 20 times.
unlocks.reward: Rewind now covers 12 seconds (2 rounds). You retain memory of all actions in the rewound period — effective foreknowledge.

unlocks.condition: Find and identify the hourglass's maker — their name, their era, and why they made something that lies about time.
unlocks.reward: Once per week: fast-forward instead of rewind — skip 1 round entirely (your turn doesn't occur, nothing acts against you, you emerge at next round's start fully rid of one condition).

unlocks.condition: Convince someone of something completely false — a lie that genuinely changes their long-term behavior — using the hourglass's temporal aura to make the lie feel like memory.
unlocks.reward: The hourglass stops lying. Once per day: see exactly 6 seconds into the future with certainty — not a guess, but true knowledge of what will happen next round in initiative order, including all enemy actions and targets.

name: Compass of the Wayward Star
flavorText: An old brass compass that has never pointed north.
description: Needle always points toward whatever the holder most fears to find. Spins wildly if pointed at the holder's own reflection. Cannot be set to point elsewhere.

unlocks.condition: Use the compass to knowingly walk toward whatever it points at, 5 separate times.
unlocks.reward: You may now ask the compass to instead point toward what you most hope to find, once per long rest, though it may still show what you fear if the two are closely entangled.

unlocks.condition: Confront and overcome the specific thing the compass revealed you feared.
unlocks.reward: The compass no longer spins wildly when pointed at your own reflection — instead it points true north, functioning as a reliable compass whenever you don't need it to be anything more.

name: Mask of the Silent Choir
flavorText: A plain wooden mask worn by a monastery that vowed never to be heard again.
description: +2 AC. The wearer's voice cannot be heard beyond 5 feet unless they choose otherwise. Occasionally hums in perfect harmony with anyone nearby. Requires attunement.

unlocks.condition: Go an entire adventuring day without speaking above a whisper while wearing the mask.
unlocks.reward: You gain advantage on Stealth checks made to avoid being heard, in addition to the mask's existing effects.

unlocks.tierLabel: Tier II — A Harmony of One
unlocks.condition: Successfully sneak past 10 creatures who should reasonably have heard you, while wearing the mask.
unlocks.reward: Once per long rest, the mask's hum can be directed at one creature within 30 ft. as an action — DC 15 Wisdom save or that creature is charmed for 1 minute, perceiving the hum as a lullaby.

name: The Debt Collector's Ledger
flavorText: A heavy leather ledger that binds any debt spoken aloud into its pages.
description: Once per month: call in any recorded debt, compelling a single reasonable favor (Geas equivalent, DC 20 Wisdom save to resist). New entries occasionally appear on their own — debts the holder didn't know they owed.

unlocks.condition: Successfully compel 5 favors using the Ledger's Geas ability.
unlocks.reward: Debts can compound into standing obligations — ongoing service instead of a single act. Up to 3 active obligations at once.

unlocks.condition: Collect on a debt from a king, deity, or CR 20+ entity — the favor must actually be delivered.
unlocks.reward: Once per month, the Ledger informs you of one significant obligation a powerful creature (CR 15+) has to the world. You can call it in as if written in your Ledger — they cannot refuse.

unlocks.condition: Forgive a debt — intentionally release someone from an obligation in the Ledger with nothing in return, in genuine goodwill.
unlocks.reward: The Ledger begins recording debts owed to you by the universe. Once per day: spend a debt-credit to declare that something that just failed (a roll, an action) succeeded instead. The universe owed you this one.

name: Hammer of Thunderbolts
flavorText: A massive warhammer with a head the size of a man's chest, inscribed with storm runes.
description: Deals 2d6+1 bludgeoning damage. Giant-slaying: +2d6 additional damage vs. giants. Thrown (range 20/60): returns. On a hit against a giant: DC 17 Constitution save or stunned until end of their next turn. While attuned with Belt of Giant Strength AND Gauntlets of Ogre Power: +5 attack and damage, giant hit DC 17 Wisdom or Frightened of you for 1 minute. Requires attunement.

unlocks.tierLabel: Tier I — Thunder Remembers Its Name
unlocks.condition: Score a killing blow against a giant using this hammer.
unlocks.reward: The giant-slaying bonus damage increases to 3d6, and the hammer's thrown range increases to 30/90.

unlocks.tierLabel: Tier II — Worthy of the Storm (Curse)
unlocks.condition: Defeat 5 giants total with this hammer.
unlocks.reward: Permanently attuned. On any critical hit, the target is also stunned until the end of its next turn (DC 17 Constitution save negates), but each throw leaves your hands numb — disadvantage on Dexterity checks requiring fine manipulation for 1 minute after each throw.

name: Lyre of Building
flavorText: A silver-strung lyre with a resonant wooden body.
description: Requires attunement by a bard. While playing: structures and objects within 300 ft. are immune to damage from siege weapons and spells. Play for 30 minutes: construction magic — work of up to 100 workers for 24 hours is completed instantly (walls, bridges, buildings). Once per 30 days.

unlocks.tierLabel: Tier I — A Song for Foundations
unlocks.condition: Use the lyre to protect a structure that is later actually attacked while the protection is active.
unlocks.reward: The protective radius increases to 500 ft., and structures within it also can't be damaged by natural disasters (fire, flood, earthquake) while you play.

unlocks.condition: Play the lyre to aid construction or repair on 3 separate structures.
unlocks.reward: You may now also use the lyre's construction-aid effect (accelerating repair/building work) even while its damage-immunity effect is not active, as a separate use of the same action.

name: Potion of Supreme Healing
flavorText: A brilliant ruby potion that practically glows with life.
description: Restores 10d4+20 hit points. Action to drink.

unlocks.tierLabel: Tier I — More Than the Dose
unlocks.condition: Drink or administer a Potion of Supreme Healing (or another found later) 3 times over the course of your adventures.
unlocks.reward: Future potions of this kind restore an additional 2d4 HP and remove one level of exhaustion.

name: Spell Scroll (7th Level)
flavorText: A scroll inscribed on shimmering silver vellum, sealed with multiple overlapping wax seals.
description: Single use. DC 17 Arcana check if not on your class spell list. Scroll crumbles after use.

unlocks.condition: Successfully cast spells from 3 different 7th-level scrolls (found across your adventures).
unlocks.reward: The Arcana check required to cast from a 7th-level scroll not on your class list is reduced by 3, and failure no longer destroys the scroll.

name: Spell Scroll (8th Level)
flavorText: An immense scroll on stretched vellum with an 8th-level spell in golden script.
description: Single use. DC 18 Arcana check if not on your class spell list. Scroll crumbles after use.

unlocks.condition: Successfully cast spells from 3 different 8th-level scrolls (found across your adventures).
unlocks.reward: The Arcana check required to cast from an 8th-level scroll not on your class list is reduced by 3, and failure no longer destroys the scroll.

name: Spell Scroll (9th Level)
flavorText: A scroll contained in a sealed platinum tube. The inscription shifts as you read it.
description: Single use. DC 19 Arcana check if not on your class spell list. Scroll crumbles after use. Contains a single 9th-level spell — roll or GM assigns.

unlocks.condition: Successfully cast a spell from a 9th-level scroll.
unlocks.reward: The Arcana check required to cast a 9th-level scroll not on your class list is reduced by 3, and on a failed check the scroll is merely blank for 24 hours rather than destroyed.

name: Astral Shard
flavorText: A jagged crystal taken from the Astral Plane that still crackles with psychic energy.
description: Requires attunement by a sorcerer. While holding: +2 to spell attack rolls and spell save DC. Once per day: when you use a Metamagic option, you can teleport up to 30 ft. to an unoccupied space you can see (bonus action).

unlocks.condition: Use Metamagic in combination with the shard's damage-boosting ability 10 times.
unlocks.reward: The bonus damage die from the shard's ability increases by one step, and its use is available twice per day instead of once.

unlocks.tierLabel: Tier II — A Fragment of Somewhere Else
unlocks.condition: Cast a spell of 6th level or higher while holding the shard.
unlocks.reward: Once per long rest, reduce the sorcery point cost of a Metamagic option by 1 (minimum 1) when used with a spell empowered by the shard.

name: Cauldron of Rebirth (Greater)
flavorText: A massive cauldron of black iron etched with the faces of forgotten heroes.
description: Requires attunement by a druid or cleric. Once per day: cast True Resurrection (no spell slot, no components other than 25,000 gp in diamonds, which the cauldron consumes). Additionally: creatures revived this way return with all their hit points and no exhaustion.

unlocks.condition: Successfully use the cauldron to cast True Resurrection.
unlocks.reward: The diamond dust cost for future castings is reduced by 5,000 gp (minimum 5,000 gp).

unlocks.tierLabel: Tier II — A Second Chance, Freely Given
unlocks.condition: Use the cauldron to restore a creature who died protecting someone else.
unlocks.reward: Once per year, the cauldron can cast True Resurrection without any material component cost at all, so long as the caster can name the person the deceased died protecting.

name: Crystalline Chronicle
flavorText: An ornate crystal sphere that records and stores spell knowledge.
description: Requires attunement by a wizard. Functions as a spellbook. +2 to spell save DC and spell attack rolls. While holding: can cast one spell from the Chronicle without expending a spell slot once per day. Chronicle holds up to 100 spells.

unlocks.condition: Successfully copy or learn 5 spells into the Chronicle.
unlocks.reward: The spell save DC and spell attack bonus granted increase to +3, and you may prepare one additional spell per long rest while attuned.

unlocks.tierLabel: Tier II — A Library That Answers Back
unlocks.condition: Successfully cast a spell of 8th level or higher using the Chronicle's stored spells.
unlocks.reward: Once per long rest, cast any spell of 5th level or lower stored in the Chronicle without expending a spell slot.

name: Far Realm Shard
flavorText: A shard of crystallized unreality taken from the Far Realm. Looking at it too long is inadvisable.
description: Requires attunement by a sorcerer. While holding: +2 to spell save DC. Once per day as a bonus action: when you cast a spell that deals damage, you can have one target take 3d8 psychic damage and become Incapacitated until end of their next turn (DC 15 Intelligence save to negate).

unlocks.tierLabel: Tier I — A Whisper From Elsewhere
unlocks.condition: Trigger the shard's damage-boosting Metamagic effect 10 times.
unlocks.reward: The bonus damage increases by one die step, and once per long rest the triggered spell also imposes disadvantage on the target's next saving throw.

unlocks.tierLabel: Tier II — It Is Looking Back (Curse)
unlocks.condition: Trigger the shard's effect against a creature native to the Far Realm or a similarly alien plane.
unlocks.reward: Permanently attuned. The shard's bonus is available twice per day, but once per long rest you must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom save or perceive something briefly that unsettles you — disadvantage on your next Wisdom saving throw within the hour.

name: Grimoire Infinitus
flavorText: An enormous spellbook that seems to have no last page.
description: Requires attunement by a wizard. +2 to spell save DC and spell attack rolls. The book has infinite pages — can store unlimited spells. Once per long rest: read aloud from it to cast any spell in it without expending a spell slot (8th level or lower).

unlocks.tierLabel: Tier I — No Page Left Blank
unlocks.condition: Store 10 different spells within the grimoire.
unlocks.reward: You may prepare one additional spell per long rest while attuned, and the grimoire can now hold spells of any level you can cast.

unlocks.tierLabel: Tier II — Every Story Ever Written
unlocks.condition: Use the grimoire's stored spells to defeat a creature with legendary actions.
unlocks.reward: Once per long rest, cast a stored spell of 4th level or lower without expending a spell slot.

name: Obsidian Flint Dragon Plate
flavorText: Full plate armor of volcanic obsidian inlaid with fire dragon scales, impossibly smooth.
description: AC 19. Immunity to fire damage. While wearing: fire breath-like attacks you make deal +2d6 fire damage. As a bonus action: breathe fire in a 30-ft cone — 10d6 fire damage (DC 18 Dex for half). Once per day.

unlocks.tierLabel: Tier I — Forged in the Old Fire
unlocks.condition: Survive an attack that would have killed a creature without your fire immunity.
unlocks.reward: Your fire breath attack's damage increases by 2d6, and its recharge becomes available on a short rest instead of only once per long rest.

unlocks.tierLabel: Tier II — The Plate Remembers the Forge
unlocks.condition: Defeat a dragon or fire-based creature while wearing this armor.
unlocks.reward: Once per long rest, when you use the bonus-action fire breath, you may do so twice in the same turn (using both your action and bonus action).

name: Rod of the Vonindod
flavorText: A massive iron rod with a crackling crown of electrical energy.
description: +3 attack and damage (2-handed, bludgeoning). On a critical hit: discharge 12d8 lightning in a 10-ft radius (DC 18 Dex for half). While holding: immune to lightning damage, can sense metallic objects within 60 ft. Once per day: cast Chain Lightning (DC 18, 10d8). Requires attunement.

unlocks.condition: Score 3 critical hits with the rod, triggering its lightning discharge each time.
unlocks.reward: The lightning discharge radius increases to 15 ft., and the save DC increases by 1.

unlocks.tierLabel: Tier II — The Storm Wants Out (Curse)
unlocks.condition: Trigger the rod's lightning discharge 10 times total.
unlocks.reward: Permanently attuned. The discharge damage increases to 15d8, but each discharge that hits you as well as your enemies (from being within your own radius) can no longer be avoided — you take half damage on a failed save exactly as your enemies do.

name: Hide of the Feral Guardian
flavorText: Tanned hide armor made from the pelt of a celestial beast. Covered in glowing runes.
description: AC 14 + Dex modifier (max 2). Requires attunement by a druid or ranger. While wearing: cast Polymorph (self only, beast form) once per day without concentration — lasts 1 hour. Beast form: maximum challenge rating equal to your level. While transformed: advantage on Perception and Survival checks.

unlocks.condition: Successfully protect an ally from a killing blow while in beast form granted by this armor.
unlocks.reward: You may now cast Polymorph (self only, beast form) twice per long rest instead of once.

unlocks.condition: Spend a combined total of 8 hours in beast form granted by this armor.
unlocks.reward: While in beast form via this armor, you retain the ability to cast spells with only verbal components, in addition to your normal beast-form limitations.

name: Hollow Dragon
flavorText: A hollow figurine of a dragon carved from clear crystal. A tiny heartbeat can be felt through it.
description: Requires attunement. Once per long rest: speak the command word — the figurine shatters, calling the spirit of the dragon it represented. The spirit acts as a draconic ally for 1 hour (statistics of an Adult Dragon of its type, half maximum HP). After 1 hour or when reduced to 0 HP, the spirit departs and the figurine is destroyed.

unlocks.tierLabel: Tier I — The Spirit Answers Faster
unlocks.condition: Summon the dragon spirit and have it survive an entire encounter.
unlocks.reward: The figurine reforms after only 5 days instead of requiring a full long rest cycle, and the summoned spirit arrives with full hit points even if it was reduced low in a previous summoning.

unlocks.tierLabel: Tier II — A Bond Beyond Shattering
unlocks.condition: Summon the dragon spirit 5 separate times.
unlocks.reward: You may communicate telepathically with the dragon spirit for the duration of its summoning, and it acts on your turn immediately rather than requiring an additional command.

name: Sword of Answering (Wildemount)
flavorText: One of the legendary Vestiges of Divergence — a blade that grows with its wielder.
description: Dormant: +2 attack/damage. Awakened (over time): +3 attack/damage, +1d6 radiant damage on hit. Exalted (over time): +3 attack/damage, +2d6 radiant, advantage on all saving throws. Requires attunement. Grows as the wielder achieves great deeds.

unlocks.tierLabel: Tier I — The Sword Recognizes You
unlocks.condition: Reach the sword's Exalted state (through its normal awakening process) and win a significant battle while wielding it.
unlocks.reward: Once Exalted, the radiant damage increases to 3d6, and the sword's bonus to attack and damage persists even if you are momentarily disarmed and immediately reclaim it (within 1 minute).

unlocks.tierLabel: Tier II — A Voice That Answers Back
unlocks.condition: Carry the sword, Exalted, through 3 more significant battles.
unlocks.reward: The sword can now speak a short warning to you (as a free action on its part) when you are about to be surprised or ambushed, once per long rest.

name: The Wandering Tower
flavorText: A miniature iron tower that fits in the palm of your hand, cold to the touch, with tiny lights visible in the windows.
description: Once per day: place it on a surface — it expands to a 20-ft square, 60-ft tall stone tower with 4 floors, crenelations, and an iron door only you can open from outside. Fully furnished. Command word to collapse it (must be unoccupied). 30 creatures can shelter inside comfortably.

unlocks.tierLabel: Tier I — A Home That Follows
unlocks.condition: Successfully use the tower for shelter during a genuine emergency (storm, ambush, pursuit).
unlocks.reward: The tower gains a 5th floor with a small kitchen and washroom, and can now be summoned as a bonus action instead of an action.

unlocks.tierLabel: Tier II — Rooms It Didn't Have Before
unlocks.condition: Use the tower as a base of operations for at least 7 in-game days.
unlocks.reward: Once per long rest, one door on the ground floor can be designated to open onto a location you have previously visited, functioning as a one-way Teleportation Circle for that use only.

name: Calamity Blade
flavorText: A greatsword of ancient make, forged during the Age of Arcanum. The blade is covered in tiny fracture lines that glow red when drawn.
description: +3 attack and damage. On a hit: deal +2d6 force damage. On a critical hit: the target must make DC 17 Constitution save or have one of their ability scores reduced by 1d4 (your choice which) until they complete a long rest. Requires attunement.

unlocks.tierLabel: Tier I — The Blade Remembers the Score
unlocks.condition: Reduce 5 different creatures' ability scores using the blade's critical hit effect.
unlocks.reward: The critical save DC increases to 19, and a failed save now reduces the ability score by 1d6 instead of 1d4.

unlocks.tierLabel: Tier II — Calamity Answers to No One (Curse)
unlocks.condition: Trigger the blade's critical effect against 10 different creatures total.
unlocks.reward: Permanently attuned — cannot be removed voluntarily. The force damage on every hit increases to 3d6, but once per long rest when you score a critical hit, you must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom save or immediately attack the nearest creature (ally or enemy) on your next turn.

name: Adamantine Plate Armor
flavorText: Full plate forged from adamantine, fitted to cover the torso, shoulders, and hips.
description: AC 20. Heavy armor. Requires 15 Strength or speed is reduced by 10 ft. Disadvantage on Stealth checks. While wearing this armor, any critical hit against you is treated as a normal hit instead. Requires attunement.

name: Adamantine Plate Helm
flavorText: A full-face adamantine helm matched to a plate armor set.
description: +2 bonus to AC. Requires attunement.

name: Adamantine Plate Gauntlets
flavorText: Articulated adamantine gauntlets, hinged at the knuckles for a full grip.
description: +2 bonus to AC. Requires attunement.

name: Adamantine Plate Greaves
flavorText: Adamantine greaves covering the thighs and shins, buckled at the sides.
description: +2 bonus to AC. Requires attunement.

name: Adamantine Plate Boots
flavorText: Reinforced adamantine sabatons with articulated toe plates.
description: +2 bonus to AC. Requires attunement.

name: Adamantine Plate Shield
flavorText: A kite shield of solid adamantine, sized to match a full plate ensemble.
description: +3 AC. While actively blocking, a critical hit against you from the blocked direction is treated as a normal hit instead. Requires attunement.

name: Adamantine Shortsword
flavorText: A adamantine a short, balanced blade suited to quick strikes.
description: Finesse, light. +2 to attack and damage rolls. Attacks made with this weapon that hit an object automatically score a critical hit against it.

name: Adamantine Longsword
flavorText: A adamantine a straight double-edged blade about a yard long.
description: Versatile (1d10). +2 to attack and damage rolls. Attacks made with this weapon that hit an object automatically score a critical hit against it.

name: Adamantine Dagger
flavorText: A adamantine a short double-edged blade with a simple crossguard.
description: Finesse, light, thrown (range 20/60). +2 to attack and damage rolls. Attacks made with this weapon that hit an object automatically score a critical hit against it.

name: Adamantine Mace
flavorText: A adamantine a flanged metal head on a sturdy haft.
description: Bludgeoning. +2 to attack and damage rolls. Attacks made with this weapon that hit an object automatically score a critical hit against it.

name: Adamantine Battleaxe
flavorText: A adamantine a broad single-bladed axe head on a long haft.
description: Versatile (1d10). +2 to attack and damage rolls. Attacks made with this weapon that hit an object automatically score a critical hit against it.

name: Adamantine Warhammer
flavorText: A adamantine a heavy square hammerhead built for crushing blows.
description: Versatile (1d10). +2 to attack and damage rolls. Attacks made with this weapon that hit an object automatically score a critical hit against it.

name: Adamantine Spear
flavorText: A adamantine a long haft tipped with a leaf-shaped point.
description: Thrown (range 20/60), versatile (1d8). +2 to attack and damage rolls. Attacks made with this weapon that hit an object automatically score a critical hit against it.

name: Sworn Bronze Wyrmling
flavorText: A young bronze dragon, not yet full-grown, who has sworn an oath of protection over its chosen companion for reasons it considers private.
description: Breath weapon (twice per short rest): 40-ft line, 8d8 lightning damage, DC 17 Dex save for half — usable to defend its owner. Water breathing while nearby. Advantage on saving throws against being charmed or frightened while it's within 30 ft.

unlocks.condition: Use the wyrmling's breath weapon to turn a battle that should have been a loss.
unlocks.reward: Breath weapon damage increases to 10d8, usable three times per short rest.

unlocks.condition: Learn the private reason for the wyrmling's oath, from the wyrmling itself, once it finally trusts you enough to say.
unlocks.reward: +2 Charisma. The wyrmling's charm/fear immunity becomes permanent and always-on, extending to a 60-ft radius around it that protects everyone in range, not just itself.

name: Phoenix Chick
flavorText: A newly-hatched phoenix, small and unassuming, faintly warm to the touch, radiating quiet certainty that it cannot really die.
description: Once per long rest, if its owner drops to 0 HP, the chick can expend itself in a burst of restorative flame, fully healing the owner and removing one condition of the owner's choice — then requires a week to be reborn from its own ashes before it can do so again. While alive, it sheds warm light (20 ft.) and grants its owner resistance to fire damage.

unlocks.tierLabel: Tier I — Certain It Cannot Die
unlocks.condition: Survive being fully healed by the chick's sacrifice, and see it through its week of rebirth.
unlocks.reward: The chick's restorative flame can now also revive its owner from death (within 1 minute of dying), not just heal them from 0 HP, still requiring a week to be reborn afterward.

unlocks.condition: Carry the chick through its rebirth three times, staying with it each time until it hatches anew.
unlocks.reward: The rebirth period shortens to 24 hours, and its fire resistance extends to a 10-ft radius around its owner.

name: Bound Lantern Archon
flavorText: A small sphere of gentle, ever-present light bound in perpetual service by an old and largely forgotten pact.
description: Sheds bright light 30 ft., dim light 30 ft. beyond, at will. Can cast Daylight once per short rest and Guiding Bolt (4d6 radiant) once per short rest on its owner's behalf. Immune to being surprised by evil-aligned creatures while it's within 30 ft.

unlocks.tierLabel: Tier I — Light Against the Dark
unlocks.condition: Use the archon's light or Guiding Bolt to turn a fight against real darkness — undead, fiends, or literal shadow — in your favor.
unlocks.reward: Guiding Bolt can now be cast twice per short rest, dealing 6d6 radiant, and Daylight no longer requires a rest to recast once its previous casting has ended.

unlocks.condition: Learn the old pact that binds the archon, and choose — with the archon's own input — to renew it freely rather than leave it bound.
unlocks.reward: +2 Wisdom. The archon's immunity to being surprised by evil creatures extends to its owner as well, within 30 ft.

name: Pegasus
flavorText: A winged horse of unmistakably noble bearing, who will only bear a rider it judges to be good at heart.
description: Speed 60 ft., fly speed 90 ft. Rider gains +3 to attack rolls made while mounted and airborne. Advantage on all saving throws against being frightened while mounted. Once per short rest, the pegasus can dive-kick (4d6+5 bludgeoning) to assist the rider.

unlocks.condition: Win a real aerial battle astride the pegasus.
unlocks.reward: The attack bonus while mounted and airborne increases to +4, and the dive-kick can be used twice per short rest.

unlocks.condition: Prove yourself good at heart in a moment that cost you something real, with the pegasus as the only witness.
unlocks.reward: Fly speed increases to 120 ft., and the frightened-immunity while mounted extends to a 30-ft radius around the pegasus, protecting nearby allies too.

name: Bonded Griffon
flavorText: A full-grown griffon, eagle-headed and lion-bodied, bonded for life to one rider it chose itself.
description: Speed 50 ft., fly speed 80 ft. Rider gains +3 to attack rolls while mounted. The griffon fights alongside its rider every round, attacking independently with its own claws and beak (2d6+5 slashing, 2d10+5 piercing) — no per-day limit.

unlocks.condition: Fight a real battle together with the griffon, each of you covering the other, and win.
unlocks.reward: The attack bonus while mounted increases to +4, and the griffon's claw and beak damage increase to 2d6+6 and 2d10+6.

unlocks.tierLabel: Tier II — Bonded for Life, Tested
unlocks.condition: The bond between you and the griffon is tested by a choice that could have ended it, and it doesn't.
unlocks.reward: Speed increases to 60 ft., fly speed to 100 ft., and the griffon now shares a passive Perception advantage with its rider at all times.

name: Scimitar of the Galebound
flavorText: Legend disagrees about who first made this scimitar — only that whoever it was clearly did not intend for it to still be in use. It reacts, faintly and unmistakably, to the presence of the gale.
description: +4 to attack and damage rolls. Finesse. Once per turn on a hit, a gust adds an extra 2d8 thunder damage and pushes the target 10 ft. directly away from you. Requires attunement by a creature willing to bear what comes with it.

unlocks.condition: Carry this weapon through a battle you had no reasonable expectation of surviving, and survive it.
unlocks.reward: The bonus to attack and damage rolls permanently increases to +5. Once per turn on a hit, a gust adds an extra 2d8 thunder damage and pushes the target 10 ft. directly away from you.

unlocks.condition: Win by a method that technically honors the rules and completely betrays their spirit.
unlocks.reward: +6 to attack and damage rolls permanently. In exchange, it can no longer be willingly set down or given away while you live — removing it requires a Wish or its equivalent.

name: Nalion, the Mindbreaker
flavorText: Something about this war pick suggests it was never really finished being made — only set down, for a while. It reacts, faintly and unmistakably, to the presence of the shadow.
description: +4 to attack and damage rolls. On a hit while you are in dim light or darkness, deal an extra 2d8 psychic damage. Requires attunement by a creature willing to bear what comes with it.

unlocks.condition: Land the killing blow on 10 different creatures with this weapon.
unlocks.reward: The bonus to attack and damage rolls permanently increases to +5. Now, on every hit, while you are in dim light or darkness, deal an extra 2d8 psychic damage.

unlocks.condition: Learn this item's true origin from a source that has no reason to lie to you, and accept what that means.
unlocks.reward: Its signature effect no longer requires a hit to trigger once per turn — it happens automatically at the start of each of your turns in combat, no action required.

name: Myrith, the Faithful
flavorText: Legend disagrees about who first made this battleaxe — only that whoever it was clearly did not intend for it to still be in use. It reacts, faintly and unmistakably, to the presence of swiftness.
description: +4 to attack and damage rolls. Versatile (1d10+4). Once per turn when you hit with this weapon, your walking speed increases by 10 ft. until the start of your next turn. Requires attunement by a creature willing to bear what comes with it.

unlocks.condition: Carry this weapon through a battle you had no reasonable expectation of surviving, and survive it.
unlocks.reward: The bonus to attack and damage rolls permanently increases to +5. Once per turn when you hit with this weapon, your walking speed increases by 10 ft. until the start of your next turn.

unlocks.condition: Use this item to do something its maker would clearly not have approved of.
unlocks.reward: +6 to attack and damage rolls permanently. In exchange, it can no longer be willingly set down or given away while you live — removing it requires a Wish or its equivalent.

name: Sileth Grimion, the Burning Vow
flavorText: This kukri has outlived every person who ever claimed to have tamed it. Those who have carried it long enough report dreams that smell, unmistakably, of the ember flame.
description: +4 to attack and damage rolls. Finesse. On a hit, the wound cauterizes into flame for an extra 2d8 fire damage. Sheds dim firelight 10 ft. while drawn. Requires attunement by a creature willing to bear what comes with it.

unlocks.condition: Carry this weapon through a battle you had no reasonable expectation of surviving, and survive it.
unlocks.reward: The bonus to attack and damage rolls permanently increases to +5. Now, on every hit, the wound cauterizes into flame for an extra 2d8 fire damage. Sheds dim firelight 10 ft. while drawn.

unlocks.condition: Use this item to do something its maker would clearly not have approved of.
unlocks.reward: +6 to attack and damage rolls permanently. In exchange, it can no longer be willingly set down or given away while you live — removing it requires a Wish or its equivalent.

name: Silorn Fenume, the Winter's Edge
flavorText: Something about this trident suggests it was never really finished being made — only set down, for a while. Scholars who've studied it agree on exactly one thing: it is not finished with the tide yet.
description: +4 to attack and damage rolls. Thrown (range 20/60), Versatile (1d8+4). On a hit, a wave of pressure adds an extra 2d8 cold damage and the target must succeed on a DC 18 Strength save or be knocked Prone. Requires attunement by a creature willing to bear what comes with it.

unlocks.condition: Score 5 critical hits with this weapon across any number of encounters.
unlocks.reward: The bonus to attack and damage rolls permanently increases to +5. Now, on every hit, a wave of pressure adds an extra 2d8 cold damage and the target must succeed on a DC 18 Strength save or be knocked Prone.

unlocks.condition: Keep this item after being given a genuine, fair chance to be rid of it.
unlocks.reward: +6 to attack and damage rolls permanently. In exchange, it can no longer be willingly set down or given away while you live — removing it requires a Wish or its equivalent.

name: Nalorn, the Echo of War
flavorText: This greataxe has outlived every person who ever claimed to have tamed it. It does not ask permission before drawing on the gale. It simply does.
description: +4 to attack and damage rolls. Once per turn on a hit, a gust adds an extra 2d8 thunder damage and pushes the target 10 ft. directly away from you. Requires attunement by a creature willing to bear what comes with it.

unlocks.condition: Carry this weapon through a battle you had no reasonable expectation of surviving, and survive it.
unlocks.reward: The bonus to attack and damage rolls permanently increases to +5. Once per turn on a hit, a gust adds an extra 2d8 thunder damage and pushes the target 10 ft. directly away from you.

unlocks.condition: Keep this item after being given a genuine, fair chance to be rid of it.
unlocks.reward: +6 to attack and damage rolls permanently. In exchange, it can no longer be willingly set down or given away while you live — removing it requires a Wish or its equivalent.

name: Grimorn Aethion, the Keeper
flavorText: Legend disagrees about who first made this maul — only that whoever it was clearly did not intend for it to still be in use. Scholars who've studied it agree on exactly one thing: it is not finished with swiftness yet.
description: +4 to attack and damage rolls. Once per turn when you hit with this weapon, your walking speed increases by 10 ft. until the start of your next turn. Requires attunement by a creature willing to bear what comes with it.

unlocks.condition: Land the killing blow on 10 different creatures with this weapon.
unlocks.reward: The bonus to attack and damage rolls permanently increases to +5. Once per turn when you hit with this weapon, your walking speed increases by 10 ft. until the start of your next turn.
